title: Route 1 - Big Sur Coast Highway
direction: Runs south from the Carmel end of the mapped road along the Big Sur coast toward San Luis Obispo County.

stretches.title: Bridges and headlands
stretches.line: The northern coast, where the road crosses canyon mouths on high bridges.

stretches.title: The wild coast
stretches.line: The long, remote middle of the coast, with the mountains close to the water.

stretches.title: South to Gorda
stretches.line: A short run south along the slope above the ocean.
